composition_algorithm: retain all 63 authenticated v0.2 effective rows in exact order, then append v0_3_additional_rows in published order

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process after target-set policy parse
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: target-set grammar ID, encoding, line ending, field order, or terminal-LF rule is missing, unknown, or changed

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set hashing
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: a target path is absolute, empty, contains backslash, colon, control, or dot segment, or is not ASCII

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set hashing
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: two target rows have the same canonical path

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set hashing
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: target rows are not in strict ascending unsigned ASCII path-byte order

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set digest comparison
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: path byte length, target byte length, or target SHA-256 differs from authenticated bytes

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set digest comparison
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: target_count differs from the number of canonical rows

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set digest comparison
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: total_target_bytes differs from the sum of target byte lengths

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before target-set hashing
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: target set is empty

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import inspection of the preloader
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: native preloader omits kernel32.dll!CreateProcessW

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import inspection of the preloader
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: native preloader omits ntdll.dll!NtCreateFile

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import inspection of the preloader
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: preloader required-direct-import order differs or an unlisted import is outside its authenticated allowlist

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import inspection of the guard
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: guard imports ntdll.dll!NtCreateFile

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import inspection of the guard
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: guard omits, reorders, or changes one of the exact eleven effective v0.4 observation-call direct imports

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: after static import/export inspection of the guard
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: guard import owner DLL, full import allowlist, or PyInit_s0_runtime_handle_guard_v0_4 export differs

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: an extra directory not derived from the application row or DLL-map parents is present

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: application directory is not index zero or derived DLL parent directories are reordered

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: a canonical DLL-search directory is duplicated

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: a search directory is host-filled rather than derived from authenticated runtime rows

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: PATH, registry, current directory, user site, or another ambient source contributes a DLL directory

v0_3_additional_rows.action_boundary: before candidate import or process during runtime policy validation
v0_3_additional_rows.mutation: application directory differs from the parent of the exact verifier_application runtime row
